name: Parked-wah honk
desc: Wah parked just past the middle: a fixed, nasal mid-boost that makes a driven amp snarl

refs.why: Mick Ronson's parked wah for a honking, aggressive lead tone
Brian May's wah used in fixed positions as a tone filter
Knopfler's riff through a partly-open, fixed wah

notes: No EXP needed: the crate's parked-wah use (0.4 to 0.6); move wah to taste for more nasal (lower) or more cutting (higher)
